notes.title: UPDATE 2
notes.content:
NEW UPDATE!

For those who are launching for the first time - I remind you - [b]JUST LEAVE THE GAME AND LOG IN AGAIN![/b]

In this update:

[list]
[*] Minor bugs have been fixed
[*] New quest: Find 5 books - each will give 1000 points and will appear on the shelf at home!
[*] New skins: including old ones, you can now simply change skins and open new ones!
[*] New location: When you reach the maximum points - the last location with an interesting item will open! ːlaughing_yetiː
[/list]

That's all!

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
I REPEAT: WHEN YOU LAUNCH FOR THE FIRST TIME - EXIT THE GAME AND ENTER IT AGAIN (resolution adapts to the monitor)

In this update:

[list]
[*] Bugs fixed
[*] New way to earn points
[*] New locations and characters added
[/list]

If someone found it too hard to earn points in Shooting Range or Arm Wrestling, now there is a new way: "Color Battle"! Here you can score a large number of points much faster, but the punishment for mistakes is also a little harsher.

That is, at the moment, new content has been added for achieving points:

(in addition to achieving 2000 points)

5000 - New skin and new location "KVA-KVA"

10000 - New skin, final title and new location (near the house)

15000 - New character (the one who does not like the number 3 ːlaughing_yetiː)

That's all! If you find bugs or glitches - write!
